description: One day of the user's log with the products ticked that day (tables DAILY_LOG and PRODUCT_USE).

_id.description: log_id (UUID, binary subtype 4; the subtype cannot be checked by $jsonSchema)

schema_version.description: Version of the document shape, 1 for schema v1 (allows document-by-document migration later).

user_id.description: owner, reference to users (UUID, binary subtype 4; the subtype cannot be checked by $jsonSchema)

log_date.description: Calendar day of the user, stored as a date at 00:00 UTC (UTC)

notes.description: Free text, at most 2,000 characters; handled as special-category data.

progress_photo_id.description: progress photo of the day, reference to photos (UUID, binary subtype 4; the subtype cannot be checked by $jsonSchema)

product_id.description: ticked product, reference to products (UUID, binary subtype 4; the subtype cannot be checked by $jsonSchema)

period.description: Period of the day: AM or PM (domain d_period of the Oracle schema).

product_uses.description: Products ticked that day, one per (product, period); at most 60.
